items.headline: World Cup 2026 Enters Crucial Stages
items.body: The FIFA World Cup 2026, hosted across 16 venues in North America, is well into its knockout rounds. With the expanded format of 48 teams, the tournament has delivered intense competition, leading to a thrilling Round of 16 and Quarter-final phase.

items.headline: Tournament Format: 48 Teams, R32 Knockout
items.body: This edition features 48 nations divided into 12 groups of four. The top two from each group and the eight best third-placed teams advanced to the Round of 32, increasing the total number of matches to 104.

items.headline: Spain Advances Past Portugal in R16
items.body: Spain secured a vital 1-0 victory over Portugal in a Round of 16 clash held at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, on July 6. This win propelled them into the Quarter-finals of the tournament.

items.headline: Egypt Triumphs Over Australia in Penalties
items.body: Egypt progressed to the next stage after a dramatic penalty shootout victory against Australia in the Round of 32 on July 3. The match at AT&T Stadium ended 1-1 before Egypt won 4-2 on penalties.

items.headline: Canada Makes Historic Round of 16 Run
items.body: Canada achieved their best-ever World Cup performance by reaching the Round of 16. They secured a dramatic 1-0 victory against South Africa in the Round of 32 on June 28, before falling to Morocco 0-3 in their Round of 16 match on July 4.

items.headline: Mexico's Resilient Campaign Ends
items.body: Mexico's tournament run concluded on July 5 with a 2-3 loss to England. Despite the defeat, the team showed significant tactical improvements and a positive outlook for future tournaments, having won their group stage matches without conceding a goal and winning a direct-elimination game.

items.headline: USA's Tournament Journey
items.body: The United States, as a co-host, has been a significant presence in the tournament. Their preparations included a strong 2025 campaign under coach Mauricio Pochettino, culminating in a 5-1 victory over Uruguay. Specific tournament progress for the USMNT is pending further confirmed results.

items.headline: Semifinal Showdown in Dallas
items.body: AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, is set to host a highly anticipated semifinal match on July 14. France will face Spain in what promises to be a thrilling encounter for a spot in the World Cup Final.

items.headline: The Grand Final at MetLife Stadium
items.body: The FIFA World Cup 2026 will culminate with the Final on July 19 at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. This iconic venue will crown the new world champions.
